get_encoder: create a GPT-2 BPE Encoder from encoder JSON and vocab BPE merge files
encode_text: encode text into GPT-2 BPE token IDs using an Encoder instance
decode_tokens: decode GPT-2 BPE token IDs back into original text using an Encoder instance
bpe_merge: apply byte pair encoding merges to a token string using the Encoder bpe method
bytes_to_unicode: get a cached mapping of UTF-8 byte values to Unicode characters for BPE encoding
